description: This script is a test suite for verifying Git push options functionality, including pushing with various push options, handling push options in submodules, push options control over HTTP, and error conditions. It defines functions for setting up repository pairs and HTTP servers, and contains multiple test cases using assertions.

methods.name: mk_repo_pair
methods.description: Creates a pair of repositories and sets up hooks in the upstream repository for pre-receive and post-receive scripts to process push options.

methods.name: test_refs
methods.description: Compares the verification of refs between upstream and workbench repositories.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case with a descriptive label for successful test conditions.

methods.name: mk_http_pair
methods.description: Sets up a remote HTTP repository with optional push options acceptance and clones it locally.
